title: Part 11: which tests prove an acceptance criterion
context: computeAcTestMapping passes with no map (judgment-inputs.ts:41) and the gate overwrites its detail with 'Acceptance criteria map to tests' (ac-test-mapping.ts:51-54). gatherTraceabilityInputs reads only compliance obligations, never the frozen spec, and counts a FAILING AC-tagged test as proof (inputs.ts:87-110). AC ids are flat AC-n per spec, so 'AC-3' in an old test of another feature would look like proof if the whole test tree counted.
